subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should authenticated plugin pages extend the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor contract, or should OpenClaw permanently support the separate `registerControlUiEntryPoint` registration and two new Gateway RPCs proposed here?
rationale: This choice defines a shipped plugin SDK and Gateway protocol boundary with long-term client, compatibility, and security ownership consequences; code review cannot safely choose the permanent public API without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend plugin tabs
options.body: Add scoped launch authentication to existing path-backed tab descriptors and remove the parallel entry-point registration and listing API.

options.title: Approve parallel entry points
options.body: Keep both public contracts, but document their distinct purposes, compatibility guarantees, client support, and security ownership before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader RFC
options.body: Hold this PR until the wider Control UI contribution direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 establishes the permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Extend plugin tabs
recommendation.body: Add scoped launch authentication to existing path-backed tab descriptors and remove the parallel entry-point registration and listing API.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the merged work that established the existing path-backed plugin tab behavior this decision would extend or supersede.
